title: Dynamic Alerting Platform — Routing Profiles Schema (ADR-007)
description: JSON Schema (draft-07) for validating _routing_profiles.yaml. Defines reusable named routing configurations that tenants reference via _routing_profile.

routing_profiles.title: Routing Profiles Map
routing_profiles.description: Mapping of profile-name to routing configuration. Naming convention: team-{team}-{region} or domain-{domain}-{tier}.

routingProfile.title: Named Routing Profile
routingProfile.description: Reusable routing configuration applied as Layer 2 in the four-layer merge pipeline. Profile values override _routing_defaults but are overridden by tenant _routing.

receiver.title: Profile Receiver
receiver.description: Default receiver for tenants using this profile.

group_wait.title: Group Wait Duration
group_wait.description: Wait time before sending initial notification (Go duration). Guardrail: 5s–5m.

group_interval.title: Group Interval Duration
group_interval.description: Interval between notifications for same group (Go duration). Guardrail: 5s–5m.

repeat_interval.title: Repeat Interval Duration
repeat_interval.description: Interval for re-sending unresolved alerts (Go duration). Guardrail: 1m–72h.

routes.title: Sub-Routes
routes.description: Optional sub-routes for severity-based or label-based routing within this profile.

profileSubRoute.title: Profile Sub-Route
profileSubRoute.description: A sub-route within a profile for conditional routing (e.g., severity-based escalation).

match.title: Match Labels
match.description: Label matchers for this sub-route (e.g., {severity: critical}).

receiver.title: Receiver Configuration
receiver.$comment: #2137: a profile receiver is merged into the tenant's _routing and goes through the same route generator, so it uses the tenant schema's receiver definition instead of a second copy (the copy that lived here had drifted: 4 of 6 types, email without from, pagerduty without its key constraint). Resolves against this file's $id, which shares its base with tenant-config.schema.json's $id — so a validator must load BOTH schemas into its registry / schema store (e.g. jsonschema's referencing.Registry keyed by each $id); loading this file alone leaves the $ref unresolvable.
